record.body:
The retained 4 Hz pre-open focus refresh reproduced the same asynchronous startup failure as the original per-frame loop: after the new startup gate released, map-recenter reached eight focus writes in about two seconds, then Rockstar raised ERROR:FFFFFFFF with no C++ exception/dump and the script yielded at WAIT.

Periodic focus writes are removed completely. The native now runs once only when INPUT_MAP, INPUT_FRONTEND_PAUSE, or INPUT_FRONTEND_PAUSE_ALTERNATE is just pressed, immediately before the frontend consumes the opening input. That mirrors Rockstars one-shot focus-before-launch sequence.

Installed ASI: 144FDA14CFF5426F1406FB8909E89A0399C50F7C6A952F7F722E2A3ADAD24E19. The issue remains open with only unfeasible: auto-center retains an input-edge implementation, while the requested in-map MMB/R3 recenter remains impossible because the script thread does not tick while MAP is open. The issue was not reopened or relabeled.
